content.title: 2026 Masters purse: Prize money payout for winner, field
content.text: PGA2026 Masters purse announced: What's the prize money for this year's winner? Dan SpearsUSA TODAY NETWORKApril 11, 2026, 12:39 p.m. ETKeep Watching3The prize money for the 2026 Masters Tournament is on the rise.The purse for the Masters was released at noon Saturday, April 11, by the tournament, with an increase to $22.5 million total. That's up by $1.5 million from 2026.While the largest numbers are reserved for the top of the leaderboard, there's also a consolation for those that didn't make the weekend. Professionals who missed the cut receive $25,000.2026 Masters cut line: DeChambeau shocker leads list of players headed homeWhat's the prize money payout for the 2026 Masters?With 54 professionals making the cut, the money for those beyond 50th place will be lower than the 50th position prize.
